query.description:
Controls the amount of detail returned for each device. Defaults to FULL.

 - DEVICE_VIEW_UNSPECIFIED: When unspecified, defaults to FULL for backward compatibility.
 - DEVICE_VIEW_FULL: Returns the full device configuration with all fields populated.
 - DEVICE_VIEW_BASIC: Returns only basic device information: id, device_name, device_status.
 - DEVICE_VIEW_ID_ONLY: Returns only device IDs.
